_studyNote_root: M365 app manifest for Site Snapshot. It gives the package its tenant identity and points at the declarative agent. Remove _studyNote_* keys in a real scaffold.

description.short: On-demand health snapshot of a SharePoint site.
description.full: Site Snapshot gives an opinionated health score for a SharePoint site (storage, stale docs, external sharing, largest files) inside Microsoft 365 Copilot, and can export or email the result.
